guitar.notes: George Lynch is well known for custom Charvel and later ESP/Kamikaze superstrats with his 'skull and crossbones'/tiger graphics; medium confidence as no single guitar is as singularly iconic as e.g. EVH's Frankenstrat.

tone.target: bright 80s melodic lead with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright 80s melodic lead with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A clean/crunch foundation with Chorus for sheen, followed by a mild boost and smooth distortion into an AC30-style amp and UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet.

rig.name: Dokken - In My Dreams - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly lift the signal and enhance upper mids for lead clarity.
blocks.gap: Using Boost to simulate a clean boost pedal effect, as no dedicated pre-amp is specified.

blocks.purpose: Provide smooth, polished distortion without excessive grit or fuzz.
blocks.gap: Red Haze offers a versatile, mid-focused gain that can be dialed back for 'smooth' lead tones, avoiding the harshness of pure Distortion.
The target tone does not require a wah effect.

blocks.purpose: Add the required 'chorused sheen' and 80s polish to the lead lines.
Simulate the bright, articulate sound of a classic British lead amp.
blocks.gap: AC30 is ideal for bright, polished tones common in 80s rock leads.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound associated with lead tones.
blocks.gap: Matches the '4x12' clue and complements the AC30 model.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the upper mids and brightness while controlling low-end mud.
blocks.gap: Used to specifically dial in 'bright upper mids' as requested by the verdict.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth and polish to the lead lines.
blocks.gap: A touch of delay adds 'polish' without distracting from the main melody.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle, glossy ambience suitable for 80s melodic leads.
blocks.gap: Plate reverb is classic and adds sheen without sounding overly wet or cavernous.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and upper-mid definition for a polished 80s sheen.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, articulate upper mids needed for polished 80s leads.
